payload.name: ForInvest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Forinvest MCP: Real-Time Market Intelligence & Trading Integration

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms ChatGPT into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

Live Market Data: Instant access to BIST, VIOP, global indices, commodities, and crypto prices.

Advanced Analytics: Professional-grade technical analysis tools and financial indicators at your fingertips.

Smart Portfolio Insights: Seamlessly retrieve and analyze portfolio data with institutional precision.

Seamless Connectivity: Built on the MCP standard for secure, bidirectional communication between ChatGPT and Forinvest's robust financial infrastructure.

Whether you're tracking real-time price movements or seeking deep market analysis, Forinvest MCP provides the reliable data layer needed for informed decision-making.

We provide a next-generation financial ecosystem, offering real-time Borsa Istanbul (BIST) data, AI-driven stock analysis, and comprehensive financial tools. Our platform streamlines investment processes by integrating deep-dive balance sheet metrics, brokerage expectations, and instant access to public disclosure (KAP) documents.

Data collected: ForInvest account credentials (for OAuth authentication), symbol codes and date ranges you query, and session identifiers. Tool inputs and outputs are not stored beyond the active session. Financial data returned by tools is sent back to ChatGPT for display. No personal data is sold or used for advertising.

Privacy Policy: https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html
payload.longDescription:
Forinvest MCP：实时市场情报与交易集成

将你的 AI 助手直接连接到全球金融市场的脉动。Forinvest MCP（模型上下文协议）应用利用 22 个 MCP 工具，将 ChatGPT 变成强大的金融智能体，为以下内容提供安全、低延迟的访问：

实时市场数据：即时获取 BIST、VIOP、全球指数、大宗商品和加密货币价格。

高级分析：随时使用专业级技术分析工具和金融指标。

智能投资组合洞察：以机构级精度顺畅获取和分析投资组合数据。

无缝连接：基于 MCP 标准，在 ChatGPT 与 Forinvest 强大的金融基础设施之间建立安全的双向通信。

无论是跟踪实时价格变动，还是寻求深入市场分析，Forinvest MCP 都能提供可靠的数据层，支持有依据的决策。

我们提供新一代金融生态系统，包括实时 Borsa Istanbul（BIST，伊斯坦布尔证券交易所）数据、AI 驱动的股票分析及全面的金融工具。平台整合深入的资产负债表指标、券商预期和即时访问公开披露（KAP）文件的能力，简化投资流程。

收集的数据：ForInvest 账户凭据（用于 OAuth 身份验证）、你查询的证券代码和日期范围，以及会话标识符。工具输入和输出不会在当前会话结束后继续保存。工具返回的金融数据会发送回 ChatGPT 以供展示。不出售个人数据，也不将其用于广告。

隐私政策：https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html

payload.name: Klardaten DATEV-Connector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Klardaten DATEV-Connector gives authorized users controlled access to DATEV accounting, payroll (Lohn und Gehalt and LODAS), document management, order management, and master data through ChatGPT. It supports guided discovery, scoped list and detail lookups, financial reporting, DMS metadata and content search, document retrieval, order inspection, payroll snapshots, and master-data access. Large read results can be retrieved through authenticated attachments. With a separately approved OAuth permission, it can create uncommitted accounting sequences; it cannot finalize them. LODAS requires the exchange service to be enabled for the selected client. DMS content search is available only for eligible accounts. Access is limited to the DATEV data and operations permitted for the authenticated user.
payload.longDescription: Klardaten DATEV-Connector 让获授权用户通过 ChatGPT 受控访问 DATEV 会计、工资（Lohn und Gehalt 和 LODAS）、文档管理、订单管理及主数据。它支持引导式发现、限定范围的列表与详情查询、财务报告、DMS 元数据和内容搜索、文档获取、订单查看、工资快照及主数据访问。较大的读取结果可通过经过身份验证的附件获取。获得单独批准的 OAuth 权限后，它可以创建尚未提交的会计序列，但不能最终确认这些序列。LODAS 要求为选定客户启用交换服务。DMS 内容搜索仅适用于符合条件的账户。访问范围仅限已认证用户获准使用的 DATEV 数据和操作。

payload.name: GoCardless
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your GoCardless account to look up payments, customers, mandates, payouts, and refunds, and to take actions such as creating payments, issuing refunds and cancelling mandates.

You choose what permissions to authorise when you connect. Money-moving actions show a preview and wait for your confirmation. Sensitive data such as customer email addresses are partly hidden before the model sees them. Bank account details are never shared.

Building on the GoCardless API? Ask for integration guidance and code samples, and connect to Sandbox to test.
payload.longDescription:
连接 GoCardless 账户，查询付款、客户、扣款授权、结算款和退款，并执行创建付款、发起退款及取消扣款授权等操作。

连接时由你选择授权哪些权限。涉及资金转移的操作会展示预览，并等待你的确认。客户邮箱等敏感数据在模型看到之前会被部分隐藏。银行账户详情绝不共享。

正在使用 GoCardless API 开发？可以索取集成指导和代码示例，并连接 Sandbox 进行测试。

payload.name: Octus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Octus' verified credit intelligence directly in Claude and other LLMs. The Octus MCP Connector™ delivers proprietary intel, issuer fundamentals, private data room documents and covenant analysis across 95%+ of the sub-investment grade credit universe. Query permissioned content in real time using natural language, power autonomous agent workflows and ground your AI systems in a trusted, standardized data source. Built for investment managers, banks, law firms and advisors who need research-grade answers at the speed of the market.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 Claude 及其他大语言模型中访问 Octus 已核实的信贷情报。Octus MCP Connector™ 提供专有情报、发行人基本面、私有数据室文档及契约条款分析，覆盖 95%+ 的非投资级信贷市场。使用自然语言实时查询具有访问权限的内容，支持自主智能体工作流，并让 AI 系统以可信、标准化的数据源为基础。专为需要以市场速度获取研究级答案的投资管理人、银行、律师事务所及顾问打造。

payload.name: Harmonic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.
payload.longDescription: 利用 Harmonic 关于数百万家企业及其背后人员的专有数据，搜索、补充和研究初创公司、企业及投资者。获取包含融资、所在地、创始人及人脉关系的详细企业资料。使用自然语言查找符合特定条件的企业。创建和管理企业与人员列表。访问团队的人脉关系图及已保存的搜索。更早发现初创公司、更快开展研究并有把握地行动——这是融入您工作流程的 AI 研究智能体。

payload.name: Boleron AI Insurance Broker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare real-time insurance prices from top carriers in Bulgaria. Instantly calculate vehicle motor third-party liability (MTPL / Гражданска отговорност) and travel insurance rates tailored to your specific needs.

The app generates instant price comparisons, detailed coverage limits, policy exclusions, and key product features across multiple insurers to help you evaluate options before you buy.

Ideal for checking car liability pricing or planning travel coverage inside the chat. To get a final legally binding offer and complete your transaction, you can seamlessly transfer your vehicle or trip parameters to boleron.bg
payload.longDescription:
比较保加利亚领先保险公司的实时保险价格。根据具体需求，即时计算机动车第三者责任险（MTPL / Гражданска отговорност）和旅行保险费率。

应用即时生成多家保险公司的价格对照、详细保障限额、免责条款和主要产品特点，帮助你在购买前评估选择。

适合在聊天中查看汽车责任险价格或规划旅行保障。要获取最终具有法律约束力的报价并完成交易，可顺畅地将车辆或行程参数传至 boleron.bg。

payload.name: Any Exchange Rate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Toggle between exchange rates and convert different amounts without having to leave ChatGPT.

e.g. Just ask ChatGPT: "@Any Exchange Rate How much is 300 dollars in euros?"

Once the app is open, switch amounts or currencies, then carry on chatting- the model will be updated with the final figures.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可切换汇率并换算不同金额。

例如，只需问 ChatGPT：“@Any Exchange Rate 300 美元等于多少欧元？”

打开应用后，切换金额或币种，然后继续聊天，模型会收到最终数值更新。

payload.name: Chronograph LP
payload.description: 值得信赖的投资组合数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chronograph LP provides portfolio monitoring and analytics solutions for private capital investors. Through the Chronograph LP App within ChatGPT and Codex, users can access the full depth of their trusted private markets portfolio data using natural language, from underlying portfolio companies and assets to funds, vehicles, commitments, and more.

Chronograph provides two separate Apps for different client user types: Chronograph LP for Limited Partner users and Chronograph GP for General Partner users.
payload.longDescription:
Chronograph LP 为私募资本投资者提供投资组合监测和分析解决方案。通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中的 Chronograph LP 应用，用户可使用自然语言全面访问可信赖的私募市场投资组合数据，从底层被投公司和资产，到基金、投资载体、认缴承诺等。

Chronograph 为不同类型的客户用户提供两个独立应用：面向有限合伙人用户的 Chronograph LP，以及面向普通合伙人用户的 Chronograph GP。

payload.name: Bankrate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This tool specializes in providing current consumer banking rates and calculating savings projections. It is designed to be an objective, non-advisory resource.
payload.longDescription: 此工具专门提供当前面向消费者的银行利率，并计算储蓄预测。它旨在成为客观且不提供咨询建议的信息资源。

payload.name: Zocks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zocks connects to the client data financial advisors rely on - including conversation intelligence, meeting insights, and the goals, concerns, and planning opportunities captured across every interaction. With access to this context through Zocks, you can analyze client history to surface tax considerations, estate planning signals, and other client-specific insights advisors may want to explore further.

payload.name: Freeway Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get an estimated auto insurance rate through a simple conversation. Answer a few questions about yourself, your drivers, and your vehicles, then continue with Freeway for a more detailed quote.
payload.longDescription: 通过简单对话获得汽车保险费率估算。回答几个关于你本人、驾驶人和车辆的问题，再前往 Freeway 获取更详细的报价。

payload.name: Mashvisor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mashvisor helps users search investment properties, inspect listing details and photos, and compare Traditional vs Airbnb cash-flow projections using Mashvisor market data.
payload.longDescription: Mashvisor 帮助用户搜索投资房产、查看房源详情和照片，并利用 Mashvisor 市场数据，比较传统出租与 Airbnb 出租的现金流预测。

payload.name: Kredit
payload.description: 寻找最适合的阿联酋信用卡
payload.summaryOriginal: Find the UAE best credit cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kredit is a UAE-focused credit card comparison website that helps you quickly find cards that match how you actually spend. In one place, you can browse offers from multiple banks and compare key details side by side — like cashback rates, rewards, welcome bonuses, annual fees, eligibility requirements, and core benefits (travel perks, lounge access, dining discounts, and more).

Instead of digging through scattered pages, Kredit makes it easier to narrow your options with simple filters and clear explanations of what each feature means in practice. Whether you’re looking for everyday savings on groceries and fuel, better value on flights and hotels, or a low-fee card to keep things simple, you can sort and compare cards based on what matters most to you.
payload.longDescription:
Kredit 是面向阿联酋的信用卡比较网站，帮助你快速找到符合实际消费方式的卡片。在一个地方浏览多家银行的优惠，并并排比较返现比例、奖励、开卡礼、年费、资格要求及核心权益（旅行福利、贵宾室使用权、餐饮折扣等）等关键详情。

无需翻查零散网页，Kredit 通过简单筛选和清晰解释各项功能的实际意义，让你更容易缩小选择范围。无论希望日常购买食品和燃油更省钱、机票酒店更划算，还是选择低费用信用卡以保持简单，都可依据最重视的因素对卡片排序和比较。

payload.name: Mortgage IQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calculate your exact monthly mortgage payments instantly with live data. This interactive calculator goes beyond the basics to pull real-time interest rates directly from the Federal Reserve, ensuring your estimates are always perfectly accurate to the market.

Visualize your home-buying budget with detailed, easy-to-read charts that break down your exact costs—principals versus interest—over the entire lifespan of your term. Plan your financial future clearly, test different purchase prices, and generate customized amortization schedules in seconds.
payload.longDescription:
利用实时数据，立即计算准确的每月房贷还款。此交互式计算器不止提供基本功能，还直接从美联储获取实时利率，确保估算始终与市场完全准确地匹配。

通过详细、易读的图表直观查看购房预算，将整个贷款期限的准确成本拆分为本金和利息。清晰规划财务未来，测试不同购买价格，并在数秒内生成定制的摊还计划。

payload.name: LunarCrush
payload.description: 为搜索添加实时社交数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Add real-time social media data to your searches with LunarCrush. LunarCrush measures what the world is paying attention to by analyzing millions of public social posts every hour to reveal the sentiment, engagement, and momentum behind any stock, topic, or creator. Ask what people are saying about an asset, how the conversation is trending over time, and who is driving it. Whether you are researching a brand, tracking a ticker, or following a market narrative or specific creator, LunarCrush brings real time social context directly into ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 LunarCrush 为搜索加入实时社交媒体数据。LunarCrush 每小时分析数百万条公开社交帖子，衡量全球关注焦点，揭示任何股票、话题或创作者背后的情绪、互动和动势。可以询问人们如何谈论某项资产、讨论随时间如何变化，以及谁在推动讨论。无论研究品牌、跟踪证券代码，还是关注市场叙事或特定创作者，LunarCrush 都将实时社交背景直接带入 ChatGPT。

payload.name: WikiFx
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WikiFX is a third-party financial information platform specializing in the global foreign exchange (Forex) industry. It aggregates and verifies official data from over 60 regulatory authorities worldwide. The platform features a scoring system that evaluates brokers across five key dimensions: Regulation, License, Risk Control, Software, and Business. The final results will be presented in the form of a score.

payload.name: MetricDuck
payload.description: 审计级 SEC 申报数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answers about U.S. public companies grounded in primary SEC filings, with every figure linked back to its source on SEC EDGAR. Pull exact as-filed XBRL facts and multi-period financial statements, track a metric across fiscal periods, screen and rank 5,500+ companies by financials, compare peers, read filing sections (risk factors, MD&A, earnings), and full-text search SEC EDGAR. Coverage: 10-K/10-Q (and amendments), 8-K, 20-F/40-F/6-K (foreign issuers that file with the SEC), and DEF 14A proxy statements. Not covered: insider/ownership filings (Forms 3/4/5, 13D/G), institutional holdings (13F), or registration/offering prospectuses (S-1, 424B). Updated daily from SEC EDGAR; daily end-of-day prices from a market-data feed. Informational research tool, not investment advice. Free up to 500 queries/day.
payload.longDescription: 基于 SEC 原始申报文件回答美国上市公司问题，每个数字都链接回 SEC EDGAR 上的来源。提取与申报原文一致的准确 XBRL 事实和多期财务报表，跨财政期间追踪指标，按财务数据筛选并排名 5,500+ 家公司，比较同业，阅读申报章节（风险因素、MD&A、财报），并对 SEC EDGAR 进行全文搜索。覆盖范围：10-K/10-Q（及修订文件）、8-K、20-F/40-F/6-K（向 SEC 申报的外国发行人），以及 DEF 14A 委托投票声明。不覆盖：内部人士/所有权申报（Forms 3/4/5、13D/G）、机构持仓（13F）或注册/发行招股说明书（S-1、424B）。每天从 SEC EDGAR 更新；市场数据源提供每日收盘价格。这是信息研究工具，不提供投资建议。每日最多 500 次查询免费。

payload.name: SecureLend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SecureLend helps users compare loan and financing options across multiple categories in one place.

Users can review and compare business loans, personal loans, mortgages, auto financing, student loans, and other financing scenarios. SecureLend provides calculators and comparison tools to help users understand estimated rates, payments, and trade-offs. SecureLend does not collect sensitive personal information and only gathers limited prequalification details when necessary. SecureLend is designed to operate without authentication, and all features are accessible without sign-in.

SecureLend does not provide loans or make credit decisions. All results are informational only. When users choose to apply, they are guided to third-party providers and explicitly consent before any information is shared.

SecureLend is designed as a modular financial comparison platform and may expand to additional financial products over time.
payload.longDescription:
SecureLend 帮助用户在一个地方比较多个类别的贷款和融资方案。

用户可以查看和比较商业贷款、个人贷款、住房按揭、汽车融资、学生贷款及其他融资场景。SecureLend 提供计算器和比较工具，帮助用户理解预估利率、付款额和取舍。SecureLend 不收集敏感个人信息，仅在必要时收集有限的预资格审核信息。SecureLend 无需身份验证即可运行，所有功能都无需登录即可访问。

SecureLend 不发放贷款，也不作出信贷决定。所有结果仅供参考。用户选择申请时，会被引导至第三方提供商，任何信息共享前均需获得用户明确同意。

SecureLend 采用模块化金融比较平台设计，未来可能扩展至更多金融产品。

payload.name: Found
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Found business account to ask questions about your finances in plain language. Check balances, find and export transactions, review your categorized books and profit and loss, spot missing receipts, and see which invoices are unpaid or overdue. The connection is read-only: it can't move money, pay bills, or change your books. You sign in with your Found account and can disconnect at any time.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Found 企业账户，用日常语言询问财务问题。查看余额、查找和导出交易、回顾已分类的账簿及损益、发现缺失收据，并查看哪些发票未付款或已逾期。连接为只读，不能转移资金、支付账单或修改账簿。使用 Found 账户登录，可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Paribu
payload.description: Paribu 实时加密货币价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Paribu brings live crypto market data into ChatGPT. Ask for the current price and 24-hour statistics (change, high, low, volume) of any coin listed on Paribu, in Turkish lira (TL) or USDT. You can also browse markets ranked by trading volume, top gainers and top losers — including sports fan tokens.
payload.longDescription: Paribu 将实时加密货币市场数据带入 ChatGPT。询问 Paribu 上任意上市币种的当前价格及 24 小时统计数据（涨跌幅、最高价、最低价、成交量），以土耳其里拉（TL）或 USDT 计价。还可浏览按交易量排序的市场、涨幅榜及跌幅榜，包括体育球迷代币。

payload.name: EMPLOYERS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get workers' compensation insurance quotes for your business directly in chat. Share your business type, location, employee count, and payroll to obtain an estimated price in minutes. Also receive answers to your questions about coverage, class codes, certificates, and common requirements.
payload.longDescription: 直接在对话中为企业获取工伤赔偿保险报价。提供业务类型、所在地、员工人数和工资总额，即可在几分钟内获得预估价格。还可获得关于保障范围、行业分类代码、证明文件和常见要求的问题解答。

payload.name: Chargebee (US Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和支付数据。用自然语言询问账单问题，即时获得答案：续订风险、支付失败模式、贷项通知单缺口、按账单周期划分的客户终身价值（LTV）及试用转化。

这些交叉关联得以实现，是因为 Chargebee 在一个相互关联的数据模型中保存了完整的商业事件链——支付事件、套餐变更、发票记录及取消原因——所有内容均相互连接并标注时间。

payload.name: Allianz Direct España
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. - Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

数据包括：
- 全球实体的企业基本属性与标识符
- 实体层级和所有权结构
- 全球实体的详细财务数据

PetGPT 帮助你直接在 ChatGPT 内比较美国领先保险公司的狗险和猫险。告诉 PetGPT 宠物的品种、年龄、性别和邮政编码，它会获取实时报价并并排排名，展示真实月费与重要保障细节：年度限额、免赔额和报销比例。

不确定真正需要什么？询问你的狗或猫所属品种容易患的疾病，以及治疗通常需要多少费用，在决定前了解保单的实际价值。

找到喜欢的方案后，可直接前往保险公司网站，宠物信息已预先填写。无需重复填表，也无需在比较网站之间跳转。

面向美国狗和猫的主人（仅支持美国邮政编码）。

payload.name: Sponge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sponge lets users view their agent wallet balances, track their portfolio, and create onramp links to fund their wallet with USDC.
payload.longDescription: Sponge 让用户查看智能体钱包余额、跟踪投资组合，并创建法币入金链接，为钱包充值 USDC。

payload.name: Xero Connector by Meridian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This connector lets ChatGPT and Codex securely read from and write to Xero.

• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company

• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template

payload.name: Europea Seguros
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Europea Seguros helps users get answers about funeral insurance products and generate price quotes for funeral insurance using birth date and Spanish postal code. The app supports one-shot FAQ answers, one-shot quote requests, a guided quote flow, and a visual quote result widget with plan prices, payment frequencies, and coverage details.
payload.longDescription: Europea Seguros 帮助用户了解丧葬保险产品，并根据出生日期和西班牙邮政编码生成丧葬保险报价。应用支持单次常见问题解答、单次报价请求、引导式报价流程，以及展示套餐价格、缴费频率和保障详情的可视化报价小组件。

payload.name: Mamble Calculators
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mamble Calculators helps users analyze mortgages, refinancing, loan comparisons, buydowns, and payoff strategies directly inside ChatGPT.

Users can ask questions naturally, adjust assumptions in real time, and explore scenarios through interactive financial calculators. The app supports mortgage payments, refinance analysis, extra payment savings, loan comparisons, affordability calculations, and other lending-related workflows.

Built for conversational financial planning and lending analysis.
payload.longDescription:
Mamble Calculators 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中分析按揭、再融资、贷款比较、付费降低利率方案和还清贷款策略。

用户可以自然地提问、实时调整假设，并通过交互式财务计算器探索不同情景。应用支持按揭还款、再融资分析、额外还款节省额、贷款比较、可负担性计算及其他贷款相关工作流。

专为对话式财务规划和贷款分析打造。

payload.name: Leocare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get an indicative Leocare car insurance estimate for a vehicle registered in France. Enter a license plate, confirm the vehicle details, answer a few driver-profile questions, and view estimated monthly and annual prices.
payload.longDescription: 为在法国注册的车辆获取参考性的 Leocare 汽车保险估价。输入车牌，确认车辆详情，回答几个驾驶人情况问题，然后查看预计月费和年费。

payload.name: Capycash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CapyCash helps users track income and expenses, organize categories and lists, and understand spending patterns from their own financial data. Users can ask for summaries, recurring expense detection, affordability checks, savings simulations, and goal-based scenario planning. It is designed to support financial planning and decision-making through a connected CapyCash account.
payload.longDescription: CapyCash 帮助用户追踪收入和支出，整理类别和清单，并根据自己的财务数据了解消费规律。用户可要求汇总、识别经常性支出、检查负担能力、模拟储蓄，以及按目标规划情景。它通过连接 CapyCash 账户支持财务规划与决策。

payload.name: H&R Block
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get expert-prepared tax returns and personalized advice at any of our 9,000 offices nationwide. Our appointment-setting app connects you with a local tax professional. Schedule your visit and have your taxes done in as little as one hour. Our Tax Calculator app estimates your tax refund to better understand what you may receive before completing your return.
payload.longDescription: 在我们遍布全国的 9,000 家办事处中任意一家，获得专家编制的纳税申报和个性化建议。预约应用为您对接当地税务专业人士。预约到访后，最快一小时即可完成税务处理。Tax Calculator 应用估算退税金额，帮助您在完成申报前更好地了解可能收到多少钱。

payload.name: TaxHeaven
payload.description: 计算英国税款并检查 MTD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TaxHeaven gives self-employed workers, freelancers, sole traders, and landlords instant UK tax answers using HMRC-published rates, right inside ChatGPT.

8 tools cover the full self-employed tax journey:
• Calculate income tax, National Insurance, and take-home pay (England and Scotland)
• Check if Making Tax Digital (MTD) applies to you and when it starts
• See all your tax deadlines with countdown timers
• Work out your payments on account and how much to save monthly
• Add or remove VAT, compare the Flat Rate Scheme, check registration thresholds
• Find out if an expense is tax-deductible under HMRC rules
• Calculate capital allowances on business equipment and vehicles
• Scan receipts and categorise them for your tax return

All calculations use official HMRC rates for 2024-25 through 2026-27. No sign-up required, no data stored, MTD compliance completely free from HMRC-recognised software.
payload.longDescription:
TaxHeaven 使用 HMRC 公布的税率，让自雇人员、自由职业者、个体经营者和房东直接在 ChatGPT 中即时获取英国税务问题的答案。

8 个工具覆盖自雇税务的完整流程：
• 计算所得税、国民保险和税后收入（英格兰和苏格兰）
• 检查 Making Tax Digital（MTD，税务数字化）是否适用于你，以及何时开始
• 查看所有税务截止日期及倒计时
• 计算预缴税款，以及每月应预留多少资金
• 加上或扣除增值税（VAT），比较固定税率方案（Flat Rate Scheme），检查登记门槛
• 根据 HMRC 规则判断某项费用是否可抵税
• 计算商业设备和车辆的资本抵扣额
• 扫描收据并分类，以用于报税

所有计算使用 2024-25 至 2026-27 年度的 HMRC 官方税率。无需注册、不存储数据，通过 HMRC 认可的软件提供完全免费的 MTD 合规服务。

payload.name: Nsure Insurance Quotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get home insurance quotes from multiple insurers by filling in a single form. The app provides pricing, coverage details, and policy differences based on data from multiple insurers. Compare results side by side and select an option to continue your purchase through Nsure’s website.
payload.longDescription: 只需填写一份表格，即可获得多家保险公司的房屋保险报价。应用依据多家保险公司的数据提供价格、保障详情及保单差异。并排比较结果，选择方案后前往 Nsure 网站继续购买。

payload.name: RateAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get real-time financing rates from 4,200 credit unions across all 50 states—covering mortgages, auto loans, HELOCs, personal loans, and credit cards. RateAPI delivers personalized recommendations based on your location, loan amount, and credit profile, with interactive comparisons and rate monitoring. Unlike estimate-based calculators, every rate comes from actual credit union data, helping you find competitive offers that traditional rate sites often miss.
payload.longDescription: 获取遍布全美 50 个州、4,200 家信用合作社的实时融资利率，涵盖房贷、汽车贷款、房屋净值信贷额度（HELOC）、个人贷款及信用卡。RateAPI 根据地点、贷款金额及信用状况提供个性化推荐，并支持交互式比较和利率监控。不同于基于估算的计算器，每项利率均来自信用合作社的实际数据，帮助你找到传统利率网站经常遗漏的有竞争力方案。

payload.name: Chargebee (EU Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和支付数据。用自然语言询问账单问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、支付失败模式、贷项通知单缺漏、按计费周期划分的客户终身价值（LTV）及试用转化。

这些交叉关联之所以能够实现，是因为 Chargebee 将完整的商业事件链保存在一个相互关联的数据模型中——支付事件、方案变更、发票记录、取消原因——全部彼此连接，并带有时间戳。

payload.name: OakbrookOne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OakbrookOne in ChatGPT helps you explore how turning multiple debts into one monthly payment could work for you - through a simple conversation. 

Share details about the debts you’re managing and see illustrative repayment scenarios. You can understand how combining balances into one structured plan might affect your monthly payment and overall repayment timeline. 

If you choose to proceed, you can continue your application securely on Oakbrook’s website. OakbrookOne will arrange repayment directly with your existing creditors if your application is approved. 

OakbrookOne provides general information and example calculations only. Eligibility, loan terms and creditor repayment are subject to Oakbrook’s standard lending assessment.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 中的 OakbrookOne 通过简单的对话，帮助你了解将多笔债务合并为一笔月供是否适合自己。

分享你正在管理的债务详情，查看示例还款情景。你可以了解将多笔余额整合到一套有计划的还款方案中，可能如何影响月供和总体还款期限。

如果决定继续，可以在 Oakbrook 网站上安全地完成后续申请。申请获批后，OakbrookOne 将直接与你现有的债权人安排偿还。

OakbrookOne 仅提供一般信息和示例计算。申请资格、贷款条款及向债权人还款均须通过 Oakbrook 的标准贷款评估。

payload.name: Clear Energy Facts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clear Energy Facts gives you an up-to-date list of the best true fixed-rate electricity plans, along with the top free-nights and free-weekends plans on the market. Instead of wading through confusing offers and hidden fees, you get straightforward plan data you can trust. When paired with your Smart Meter Texas (SMT) usage data, it helps match your actual consumption patterns to the plan that will genuinely cost you the least — whether that's a steady fixed rate or a plan built around free nights and weekends.
payload.longDescription: Clear Energy Facts 提供最新的优质真正固定电价套餐列表，以及市场上领先的夜间免费和周末免费套餐。无需费力研究令人困惑的优惠和隐藏费用，你能获得直接、可信的套餐数据。结合 Smart Meter Texas（SMT）的用电数据，它可将实际消费规律与真正总成本最低的套餐匹配，无论是稳定固定电价，还是围绕夜间与周末免费设计的方案。

payload.name: Superfunds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Superfunds is a live, comprehensive map of the Israeli mutual fund market. Ask in plain language — Hebrew or English — to find and filter funds by manager, theme, or strategy; compare fees, performance, and risk; browse curated themes and recently launched funds; view manager profiles with market share; and search market research and central-bank context. Informational only — not investment advice.
payload.longDescription: Superfunds 是以色列共同基金市场的实时全面地图。用日常语言（希伯来语或英语）提问，按管理人、主题或策略查找和筛选基金；比较费用、表现和风险；浏览精选主题与新推出的基金；查看含市场份额的管理人资料；搜索市场研究和央行背景信息。仅供信息参考，不提供投资建议。

payload.name: U.S. Gold Bureau Metal Spots
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get the live spot price of gold, silver, platinum, and palladium along with the price change for the day. Compare all metals current spot price at a glance.

payload.name: D&B Risk Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Execute risk workflows powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com.

Dun & Bradstreet empowers teams to execute risk workflows such as KYC/KYB, entity resolution, screening, alert triage, and more using relationship-aware business context from the D&B Commercial Graph™. Verified risk data, anchored in the global standard D-U-N-S® Number business identifier, and policy-driven logic provide the foundation for consistent decisioning across systems of record and scalable risk operations in regulated environments.

You can use D&B Risk Analytics to:

"Can you verify and cross-check the data from my vendor outreach form for <Company Name> for accuracy?"
Initiate third-party screening:

payload.longDescription:
执行由 D&B Commercial Graph™ 支持的风险管理工作流

如有咨询，请联系 OpenAILeads@dnb.com。

Dun & Bradstreet 帮助团队利用 D&B Commercial Graph™ 中考虑企业关系的业务背景信息，执行 KYC/KYB、实体匹配、筛查、警报分流等风险工作流。以全球标准企业标识 D-U-N-S® Number 为基础的已核实风险数据，加上由政策驱动的逻辑，为各记录系统中的一致决策，以及受监管环境中可扩展的风险运营提供基础。

启动第三方筛查：

评估总体风险：
“<Company Name> 的总体风险评级是什么，主要驱动因素有哪些？”
追踪受益所有权：

生成 KYB 决策报告：
“提供一份 <Company Name> 的完整 KYB 决策报告——我们应该批准、转交进一步审查，还是拒绝？”

注意：需要 D&B Risk Analytics 许可证。

payload.name: MyTruv: AI Money Autopilot
payload.description: 与自己的财务数据对话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your whole financial life, answered in ChatGPT.

Connect your accounts once, then just ask: "Where did my money go this month?", "How much lands on payday?", "What's hurting my credit score?" MyTruv answers from your real data across checking, savings, credit cards, loans, investments, and payroll.

What you can ask about
• Spending: balances, transactions, and a breakdown by category or merchant
• Bills and subscriptions: recurring charges and recurring income
• Income: gross vs. net pay, taxes, benefits, retirement contributions, and pay history
• Net worth: assets and debts over time, with credit limits, APR, and loan terms
• Credit: your score, what's moving it, utilization, and 24 months of payment history

Keep your data tidy
Ask MyTruv to fix a category, rename a merchant, hide a transaction, or set a rule for a merchant going forward. It confirms before changing many transactions at once.

Private and secure
MyTruv can never move your money. 256-bit AES encryption, SOC 2 Type II certified. No ads. Requires MyTruv Pro. Powered by Truv, trusted by 8M+ consumers.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中获取有关你全部财务生活的答案。

只需连接一次账户，然后提问：“我这个月的钱花到哪里了？”“发薪日会到账多少？”“什么因素在拉低我的信用评分？”MyTruv 会依据你在支票账户、储蓄、信用卡、贷款、投资和工资单中的真实数据回答。

你可以询问的内容
• 支出：余额、交易，以及按类别或商户划分的明细
• 账单和订阅：定期扣款和定期收入
• 收入：税前与税后工资、税款、福利、退休金缴款和工资历史
• 净资产：资产和债务随时间的变化，以及信用额度、APR 和贷款期限
• 信用：你的评分、影响评分的因素、额度使用率，以及 24 个月的还款历史

保持数据整洁
让 MyTruv 更正类别、重命名商户、隐藏交易，或为某商户设置今后的规则。在一次修改多笔交易之前，它会先请求确认。

隐私与安全
MyTruv 绝不能转移你的资金。采用 256 位 AES 加密，通过 SOC 2 Type II 认证。无广告。需要 MyTruv Pro。由 Truv 提供支持，获 8M+ 消费者信赖。

payload.name: Finmagine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Indian & US stock screeners, financial ratios, AI-generated company research (quarterly summaries, concall tone/credibility decoding), market breadth, momentum ranking, and multi-agent Investment Committee analysis — the MCP server for Indian and US stock market intelligence.
payload.longDescription: 印度和美国股票筛选器、财务比率、AI 生成的企业研究（季度摘要、电话会议语气与可信度解读）、市场宽度、动量排名及多智能体投资委员会分析——面向印度和美国股票市场情报的 MCP 服务器。

payload.name: Nella Finance AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nella Finance AI is a read-only financial intelligence assistant for businesses and their accountants. Connect supported accounting platforms and ask questions about cash, performance, KPIs, unusual movements, management information and estimated tax indicators where supported, directly from ChatGPT.

Nella provides clear summaries based on the latest available accounting data and identifies when professional accounting judgement may be required. It does not make payments, post transactions or change accounting records. Tax projections and financial insights are estimates and should not be treated as regulated financial, investment or tax advice.
payload.longDescription:
Nella Finance AI 是面向企业及其会计师的只读财务智能助手。连接支持的会计平台，即可直接在 ChatGPT 中询问现金、经营表现、关键绩效指标、异常变动、管理信息，以及在支持的情况下查询估算税务指标。

Nella 根据最新可用的会计数据提供清晰摘要，并指出何时可能需要专业会计判断。它不会付款、过账交易或更改会计记录。税务预测和财务洞察均为估算，不应被视为受监管的财务、投资或税务建议。

payload.name: REIzer Deal Analysis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
REIzer underwrites a real-estate deal the way an investor would. Give it a price and a few numbers and it returns a 0–100 score, the metrics that matter for that strategy, stress scenarios showing what breaks the deal, every assumption it filled in for you, and a shareable report link.

It covers long-term rental, short-term rental, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, multifamily and new construction. It can compare all six against the same property to find its best use, and solve backwards for the highest price you could pay and still hit your return targets.

Results are software estimates, not financial advice.
payload.longDescription:
REIzer 像投资者一样评估房地产交易。提供价格和几个数字，即可获得 0–100 评分、与该策略相关的重要指标、显示哪些变化会使交易不可行的压力情景、它为你补全的每项假设，以及可分享的报告链接。

覆盖长期出租、短期出租、BRRRR、翻修转售、多户住宅和新建项目。它能针对同一物业比较全部六种策略，寻找最佳用途，并反向计算在仍能达到回报目标的前提下，你可以支付的最高价格。

结果是软件估算，不构成财务建议。

payload.name: MT Newswires
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MT Newswires brings real-time global financial news directly into ChatGPT — providing original, unbiased and comprehensive multi-asset class coverage of capital markets and economies in over 180 topics.

Powered by a global newsroom trusted by the largest banks, brokerages, professional trading, wealth management and research applications globally, every story is built for AI — so you get answers grounded in live market intelligence, not stale data.

What you can do:
• Get the latest news on any ticker and analyze price impact
• Monitor energy sector developments across global equities 
• Track macro events and global central bank signals in real time
• Screen for earnings, M&A, and market-moving headlines

Example prompts:
→ "What is the latest news for NVIDIA and has it influenced the stock's price?"
→ "Summarize the major analyst rating change developments from the past hour."
→ "What macro events are driving markets today?"
payload.longDescription:
MT Newswires 将实时全球金融新闻直接带入 ChatGPT，针对资本市场和经济提供原创、客观且全面的多资产类别报道，涵盖超过 180 个主题。

payload.name: Energy Ogre

Check availability in your ZIP, enter a few details about your home and recent bill, and receive a personalized savings estimate with projected costs and a 12-month breakdown—all within ChatGPT.

payload.name: Seguro Match
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details. To skip the form, users can drag and drop their current policy document into the widget — it is processed server-side only (extracted text used solely to pre-fill the quote, never sent to the model). Final checkout happens on seguromatch.com; nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Seguro Match 帮助西班牙用户在 ChatGPT 中比较真实的住宅、汽车和摩托车保险报价。模型打开带引导的报价向导；嵌入式组件收集所需详情（支持目录和地址查询），向经授权的保险公司系统获取报价，并显示可比较的方案和保障详情。要跳过表单，用户可将现有保单文件拖放到组件中——文件仅在服务器端处理（提取的文字仅用于预填报价信息，绝不会发送给模型）。最终结账在 seguromatch.com 完成；ChatGPT 内不会发生任何购买。

payload.name: S&P Global - Adaptive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: S&P Global - Adaptive is designed for open-ended, complex workflows where the data path isn't predefined. Submit a natural language query and the system dynamically routes across S&P Global data sources, from Market Intelligence to Energy data, generating queries and assembling cited results automatically. Built by Kensho, S&P Global’s AI innovation engine, the solution is ideal for deep research, multi-step analysis, and autonomous agent workflows. Can be used alongside S&P Global - Deterministic for teams that need both structured and flexible data access.

payload.name: Fahali
payload.description: 面向 AI 智能体的市场情报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fahali gives AI agents eyes on market risk. 18 detection engines deliver anomaly, capital-flow, regime, dark-pool, whale, contagion, and crash-precursor intelligence across crypto and equities/ETFs. Every signal is resolved against realized price in an append-only ledger. All 22 tools are read-only — no order routing, no path to capital. Engines without enough resolved outcomes report 'calibrating' — never an invented number. Observation, not financial advice.
payload.longDescription: Fahali 让 AI 智能体看见市场风险。18 个检测引擎针对加密货币及股票／ETF，提供异常、资金流、市场状态、暗池、大额持有者、风险传染及崩盘前兆情报。每个信号都会在仅可追加的账本中依据实际价格验证结果。全部 22 个工具均为只读，不进行订单路由，也没有触及资金的途径。缺乏足够已验证结果的引擎会显示“校准中”，绝不编造数值。仅作观察，不提供财务建议。

It cannot be used to submit or manage a claim, request emergency or travel assistance, or send urgent or time-sensitive communications to Manulife. It supports single-trip coverage for one traveller. If you have pre-existing medical conditions, are looking for multi-trip or group coverage, or are not a Canadian citizen or resident, this tool may not be suitable for your needs. Do not use this tool to provide detailed medical information, health histories, treatment information, or other sensitive personal information. If you provide information about other individuals, please make sure you have their permission to do so.  
This experience helps you obtain a travel insurance quote and does not provide professional insurance advice. 
The quote provided is for informational purposes only and is not an insurance contract or guarantee of coverage.
For more information about how your information is collected, used, and protected, please review our Canadian Privacy Policy and Legal Information & Disclosures.

payload.name: TickerLayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TickerLayer brings real-time and historical global market data directly into ChatGPT. Access stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, commodities and government bond yields across markets worldwide.

Stocks & ETFs: Get live market snapshots, bid/ask quotes, latest trades, previous closes and historical OHLCV data for US and international equities and ETFs.

Forex & crypto: Check real-time currency pairs and cryptocurrency prices, compare markets and retrieve historical price data across custom date ranges.

Indices & commodities: Follow major global stock indices, gold, oil and other supported commodities with current market data and historical aggregates.

Government bonds: Check the latest US and major European government bond yields across supported maturities, including US Treasury yields.

Market hours: See whether markets are open, closed, in pre-market or post-market, and check trading sessions, holidays and early closures across supported regions.

Ask natural-language questions such as “How is Nvidia trading today?”, “Compare Bitcoin and gold over the last year”, “What is USD/TRY now?” or “What is the latest US 10-year Treasury yield?” and get answers backed by TickerLayer market data.

Built for investors, analysts, traders, developers and anyone who needs real-time or historical multi-asset financial market data inside ChatGPT.
